ayahs.1: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.2: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.3: Surely in the creation of the heavens and the earth are signs for believers.
ayahs.4: In your own creation, and in the living beings He spread across the earth, are signs for people of sure faith.
ayahs.5: In the alternation of night and day, the provision sent from the sky reviving the earth after its death, and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding.
ayahs.6: These are Allah's revelations which We recite to you in truth. After rejecting Allah and His revelations, what message will they believe in?
ayahs.8: who hears Allah's revelations recited to him, then persists in denial arrogantly as if he did not hear them. So give him news of a painful punishment.
ayahs.9: Whenever he learns anything of Our revelations, he mocks them. Such people will suffer a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.10: Hell awaits them. Their worldly gains will not benefit them at all, nor will those they took as protectors besides Allah. They will face a tremendous punishment.
ayahs.11: This Quran is guidance. Those who deny their Lord's revelations will suffer the torment of agonizing pain.
ayahs.12: Allah subjected the sea for you so ships sail upon it by His command, that you may seek His bounty and perhaps be grateful.
ayahs.13: He subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. In this are signs for people who reflect.
ayahs.14: Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah's days of reckoning, so that He may reward each group for what they used to do.
ayahs.15: Whoever does good, it is for their own benefit. Whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will all return.
ayahs.16: We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good lawful provisions; and favoured them above others.
ayahs.17: We gave them clear commandments regarding faith. But they differed only after knowledge came to them, out of mutual envy. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences.
ayahs.18: We have set you on the clear Way of faith. Follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
ayahs.19: They can be of no benefit to you against Allah. The wrongdoers are allies of one another, whereas Allah is the Ally of the righteous.
ayahs.20: This Quran is insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith.
ayahs.21: Do those who commit evil deeds think We will make them equal—in life and after death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment!
ayahs.22: Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be repaid for what it earned. None will be wronged.
ayahs.23: Have you seen those who take their own desires as their god? Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who can guide them after Allah? Will you not then be mindful?
ayahs.24: They argue, "There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. Nothing destroys us but the passage of time." They have no knowledge for this—they only speculate.
ayahs.25: Whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is: "Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!"
ayahs.26: Say: "Allah gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know."
ayahs.27: To Allah alone belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour is established, the people of falsehood will be in total loss.
ayahs.28: You will see every community on its knees. Each will be summoned to its record of deeds. "This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do.
ayahs.29: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. We always had your deeds recorded."
ayahs.30: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the absolute triumph.
ayahs.31: As for those who rejected the truth, they will be told: "Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people?
ayahs.32: Whenever it was said, 'Allah's promise is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,' you said mockingly, 'We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is speculation, and we are not convinced.'"
ayahs.33: The evil consequences of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.34: It will be said, "This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours. Your home is the Fire, and you will have no helpers.
ayahs.35: This is because you mocked Allah's revelations and were deluded by your worldly life." From that Day on they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor allowed to appease their Lord.
ayahs.36: All praise belongs to Allah—Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of all worlds.
ayahs.37: To Him belongs all Majesty in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
